thread:
Maya: Quick sync — planning launch posts + webinar. Idea: tie free credits to onboarding prompt templates and measure activation nudges. Short experiment plan below. :sparkles:
AJ: Love it. Two arms? 'credit-first' (free credits immediately) vs 'template-first' (show curated prompt templates, credits after first API call).
Priya: Template-first sounds good for reducing support tickets. We should prep 6 prompt templates: search, summarization, email-drafts, chat-start, code-assist, customer-response.
Sam: Metrics: track 7-day activated users (first successful generation), 24h retention, avg tokens/use, and conversion to paid within 30d. We'll also run a benchmark narrative for latency & $/token during webinar demo.
Leo: For inbound routing: high-intent (company_email, >1000 tokens/month estimate) -> sales handoff; else -> self-serve funnel. I can add rule: `if email_domain not in ['gmail','yahoo'] and est_tokens>1000 -> sales`.
Nora: Add UTM tags and tag users with experiment cohort in our CRM. We'll need 1) `utm_campaign=ignite-launch`, 2) `experiment=nudge-cascade-v1`.
Maya: Timeline: copy + assets by Wed, webinar dry-run Thu, live Tue next week. Can marketing own landing + post cadence? @Leo you'll drop routing rules? :thumbsup:
Leo: Yep. I'll push routing in GA and our LeadRouter. Snippet:
```
route = lead_router.match(lead)
if lead.estimate_tokens > 1000 and not lead.is_personal:
    route.sales_queue('ignite-launch')
else:
    route.self_serve('starter-credit')
```
Sam: For benchmark narrative, I'll prep a slide comparing 3 prompt templates across cost/latency/quality with sample outputs. Need 3 exemplar prompts per template.
Priya: I'll write the template copy + short demo scripts. Can someone volunteer to run live demo? @Maya?
Maya: I can do the demo. Want to show 'template-first' flow and then reveal credits as catalyst.
AJ: A/B allocation 60/40 favoring template-first. We'll use `experiment_id=IC-2026-01`. Keep sample size 3k signups for statistical power.
Nora: I'll set up tags and a Zap to populate cohort on signup. Also will add an internal tracker in the console: `marketing.experiments.ignite_launch`.
DeployBot: calendar created: Webinar — Ignite Launch (Tue 12pm PT) — attendees: marketing, growth, product, analytics.
Maya: Great. Quick checklist: 1) landing + copy, 2) templates ready, 3) credit gating logic, 4) routing + CRM tags, 5) benchmark slides, 6) rehearsal. I'll DM owners.
Leo: One more: add an alert for sudden spike in free-credit redemption (`>1000 redemptions/hr`) so SRE doesn't get surprised.
Sam: Noted. I'll add monitoring and a cost estimate table.
Priya: Saving notes to notion: https://redwood-inference.notion.site/Ignite-Launch-Experiment-ic2026
Maya: Thanks team — see sync Thu 10am for dry-run. :rocket:
